question: A customer emails our bank asking us to delete all the data we hold on them after they closed their account. Which GDPR article governs whether we must comply?
We plan to roll out a new credit-scoring algorithm that profiles customers at scale. Which GDPR article requires us to assess the risks to individuals beforehand?
Our payment app leaked customer email addresses yesterday. Which GDPR article sets our duty to tell the regulator?
A user wants to move their full transaction history to a competing app. Which GDPR article gives them that right?
A loan applicant was rejected by an algorithm with no human involved and is complaining. Which GDPR article is most relevant?
We hired a cloud provider to process our customers' personal data on our behalf. Which GDPR article requires a binding contract with them?
A regulator is deciding how large a fine to impose on us for a data breach. Which GDPR article lists the factors it must weigh?
We are designing a new app and want the most privacy-protective settings to apply automatically. Which GDPR article requires this?
A bank wants to use AI to evaluate the creditworthiness of individuals. Which AI Act article determines whether this counts as a high-risk system?
A startup wants to put a chatbot in front of customers. Which AI Act article requires telling users they are talking to an AI?
Which AI Act article bans social scoring and emotion recognition in the workplace?
A company running a high-risk AI system wants the people overseeing it to be able to override or stop it. Which AI Act article covers this?
Which AI Act article sets the maximum fines, for example for using a prohibited AI practice?
A company is releasing a large language model for general use. Which AI Act article sets the provider's duties, such as technical documentation and a copyright policy?
A customer's card was used fraudulently and they want a refund by the end of the next business day. Which PSD2 article puts that duty on the provider?

A budgeting app wants to read the customer's balances from several banks. Which PSD2 article governs access by account information providers?
An online checkout needs to verify the payer with two independent factors. Which PSD2 article requires this?
A customer lost their card and a thief spent money before it was blocked. Which PSD2 article caps how much of that loss the payer bears?

A bank signs a cloud outsourcing agreement covering critical functions. Which DORA article lists the contract terms that must be included?
A significant bank has to run red-team style penetration tests on live systems. Which DORA article covers this?
Which DORA article makes the board responsible for approving and overseeing the ICT risk strategy?
Before engaging an ICT provider, a financial entity must assess concentration risk and keep a register of information. Which DORA article sets these general principles?
A company wants to launch a new token and must publish a document describing it. Which MiCA article defines what that document must contain?
An exchange wants to offer custody and trading of crypto-assets in the EU. Which MiCA article governs the authorisation it needs?
A trader bought tokens using non-public information about an upcoming exchange listing. Which MiCA article prohibits this?
A platform spread false rumours to push up a token's price. Which MiCA article prohibits this?
An issuer holds price-sensitive information about its token. Which MiCA article requires it to disclose it publicly?
A bank onboarding a corporate customer must identify the beneficial owner. Which AMLR article covers identification and verification of customers and beneficial owners?
A firm wants to know when it may apply lighter checks to a low-risk customer. Which AMLR article covers simplified due diligence?
A compliance officer suspects a transaction is linked to money laundering. Which AMLR article covers reporting to the FIU?
